text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo! Curren! Whatcha looking all<n>around for?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo! ☆ I was just deciding on<n>today's
streaming spot.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Your Umasta post!<n>"#CurrenBirthday" is really
trending!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wooow, you're working hard for<n>your fans, even
on your birthday,<n>huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not really. My fans are just the<n>best! They
never fail to give great<n>comments.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Even when they're busy with their<n>own jobs and
schoolwork... I can<n>always count on them.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's why today's a celebration ofboth me and my fans! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Curren... You're awesome! You're<n>such a pro—a
real can-do girl!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, oh! I wanna help too! Let me do<n>something!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aw, thanks! Let's see... Wanna<n>appear as a special
guest?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I bet everyone will be super happy to<n>see my good
friend there! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... You got it! I'll make sure the<n>comments
take off! ☆
